summary: Phase 2 full regression. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (health, contact/lead CRUD, chat IT+EN with Claude Sonnet 4.5, quote/estimate IT incl. lead persistence + invalid email, articles list IT/EN (4+4), article detail IT/EN, article 404, /api/og PNG 1200x630, sitemap.xml with /preventivo, /insights, /en, /en/quote, and article URLs). Frontend: /insights renders 4 cards; clicking navigates to /insights/:slug; article markdown renders (h2 list strong em); CTAs quote+contact present (after article fetch). /preventivo wizard 4-step flow works end-to-end with live Claude estimate (8.000-12.000€/mese range, recommended approach, next steps, fit score, CTA href /contatti). /en homepage shows English nav (Home/Services/Insights/Case Studies/About/Contact); nav-lang-switch toggles to /. /en/services/seo renders English copy correctly. AIChat on /en gets clean English reply from Claude (passes locale='en'). robots.txt reachable with Sitemap directive. ONE BUG: react-helmet-async on home page is not injecting any of the SEOHead tags (og:image, alternate hreflang, og:type, twitter, html lang dynamic). The static index.html meta remain, but SEOHead's dynamic head injection is silently failing — affects every page that depends on Helmet for SEO.

integration_issues.flow: SEO head injection via react-helmet-async (SEOHead component)
integration_issues.issue: On /, /insights and /en routes, document.head does NOT contain og:image, alternate hreflang, twitter:image, or any other tag rendered by <SEOHead/>. Only static tags from public/index.html are present. og:image pointing to /api/og?... is therefore absent (REQUIRED by phase-2 spec). html lang is overridden to empty by Helmet (locale value reaches SEOHead correctly but Helmet output never appears).

issues: Lenis warning persists: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position…' (cosmetic, no functional impact).
WebGL GPU stall warnings from Hero3D ReadPixels (cosmetic perf log).

action_items: HIGH: Debug react-helmet-async injection. Likely causes: (a) <HelmetProvider> wraps inside another StrictMode/Suspense boundary that strips children, (b) react 19 incompatibility — react-helmet-async historically has issues with React 19 concurrent rendering and may need a replacement like @vueuse/head equivalent, react-helmet, or `react-helmet-async@^2.0.5`. Quick check: open browser devtools, search head for any tags added by Helmet; if none, verify Helmet is mounted (try console: `document.head.querySelectorAll('[data-react-helmet]')`). Fix by upgrading or switching to a modern alternative (e.g., import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet' or use a HeadProvider pattern from a React-19-compatible lib).
MEDIUM (cosmetic): Add non-static position to Lenis wrapper container to silence console warning (carried over from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: SEOHead/Helmet failure is silent — no console error, no fallback. Consider verifying Helmet output in a dev assertion or switching to a maintained alternative.
QuoteCalculator persists lead BEFORE LLM call — if LLM fails the lead still exists with empty estimate metadata. Acceptable design (lead capture priority) but worth a doc comment.

estimate_quote default `_default_fit` heuristic considers budget tokens '15', '40', etc. but matching `'k' in budget.lower()` plus substring match like '15' could miss ranges like '5-10k'. Minor; works because LLM nearly always returns valid JSON.
InsightDetailPage `notFound` state correctly handles 404 with a Link back to /insights — good.
Sitemap doesn't include hreflang alternates per URL (just lists IT and EN routes separately). Acceptable but could be enhanced with <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="…"/>.
AIChat data-testid is `ai-chat-toggle` / `ai-chat-input` / `ai-chat-send` (hyphenated) — review_request mentioned different naming; current implementation works.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ lead via /api/contact and 1 quote lead via /api/quote/estimate (Italian, 5-10k budget) and 1 quote lead via /preventivo UI submission. Created 2 chat sessions (IT + EN) with 2 messages each.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs 18 tests in ~18s and validates ALL Phase 2 endpoints. The single open issue is SEOHead/react-helmet-async not injecting tags — verify by curl-rendering the SPA (it'll show only index.html static meta) OR via Playwright `document.head.innerHTML` (no og:image present). Quote wizard testids prefix `quote-objective-`, `quote-service-`, `quote-budget-`, `quote-timeline-`, `quote-input-name|email`, `quote-submit`, `quote-result`, `quote-result-cta`. Insight detail CTAs: `insight-cta-quote`, `insight-cta-contact` — both present but only AFTER article fetch resolves (~500ms after navigation); wait for `[data-testid="insight-title"]` first. AIChat testids: `ai-chat-toggle|widget|input|send`, messages `chat-message-{role}`. Language switcher testid: not exposed via `nav-lang-switch` in original spec — actual implementation uses different selector but works (clicking the Globe/EN button navigates correctly).
rca of the issue: RCA — SEOHead not injecting: react-helmet-async@latest may not be fully compatible with React 19's concurrent rendering. The <HelmetProvider> wraps the entire app correctly in App.js, and useLocale returns the correct 'it'/'en' value, but the SideEffects collector in helmet-async fails to push tags to document.head. Reproduction: open https://scroll-hero-4.preview.emergentagent.com/ → DevTools → Elements → <head> shows only the static tags from public/index.html, with no og:image/api/og or hreflang. Same on /insights/:slug. Mitigation: upgrade `react-helmet-async` to a version that supports React 19 (currently 2.0.5 supports React 18 only — pin to a community fork or migrate to `@unhead/react` or `react-helmet`), OR roll a tiny custom hook that imperatively mutates document.head from useEffect.
